one_line: Anthropic’s massive IPO fuels market sell‑off as US tightens AI chip controls and firms unveil new AI tools.

themes.title: Anthropic IPO sparks market dip
themes.text: Anthropic completed an $81.3 billion IPO, valuing the company at about $1.7 trillion and giving founders $2 billion in cash. The offering did not halt a broader AI sell‑off, with Asian technology stocks falling and Anthropic’s shares slipping more than 5% in after‑hours trading.

stories.headline: Anthropic raises $81.3B in record-breaking IPO as founders cash out $2B
Asian tech stocks plunge as Anthropic IPO fails to stem AI sell-off
Anthropic shares slide 5% in after-hours trading following record IPO

themes.title: US probes AI chip exports
themes.text: The U.S. Commerce Department approved sales of over 879,000 AI chips to Chinese firms, including entities on a defense‑linked list, while California’s attorney general issued a subpoena to Nvidia over alleged chip transfers to China. Additionally, cloud provider Nscale may need a U.S. license to continue offering Nvidia GPUs to ByteDance under new export rules.

stories.headline: US Commerce Dept approved sales of over 879K AI chips to Chinese companies
California AG subpoenas Nvidia over former CEO Jensen Huang's affair
Nscale may need US license for ByteDance GPU access under new rules

themes.title: Major firms launch new AI tools
themes.text: Google added a computer‑use capability to its Gemini desktop app for macOS, allowing background tasks across apps and the web. Apple announced hiring engineers to build an autonomous AI agent that can browse, code, and invoke services, and Canva introduced a user toggle to disable its generative‑AI features.

stories.headline: Google adds computer use to Gemini for macOS
Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
Canva adds toggle to disable generative AI features for all users

themes.title: AI models achieve scientific breakthroughs
themes.text: Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5.2 model solved two long‑standing problems in black‑hole physics, including a phase‑transition description of black‑hole formation in tiny universes. Google DeepMind researchers published an essay outlining four possible pathways from artificial general intelligence to artificial superintelligence.

stories.headline: Anthropic's Claude model solves two open problems in black hole physics
Google DeepMind institute outlines four pathways from AGI to ASI
